Method of Attack: Exploits vulnerability CVE-2017-0144 in Microsoft's SMB protocol by sending malformed packets to vulnerable SMB services, allowing remote code execution and initial foothold
Impacted Systems: Computers running vulnerable versions of SMBv1 protocol
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SMBv1 protocol vulnerability CVE-2017-0144 via malformed packets
Indicators of Compromise: Use of ETERNALBLUE exploit module in Metasploit framework; Reports of malware families using ETERNALBLUE including WannaCry ransomware, Adylkuzz miner, various RATs, UIWIX ransomware, EternalRocks worm, Gh0st RAT, Nitol backdoor
